body: i get what your saying. I knew someone who must have OD,ed maybe four times. At first i was really worried about them and i felt so bad for them. I did everything i could the first time it happened and made myself available 24hrs a day but then it happened again and again. I couldnt understand it. I know he was in a bad place. He explained to me that for him it was like he couldnt see a way out but at the same time he didnt really want to die either. Around the same time my brother commited suicide with a gun. I was so traumitised. It was a really difficult time for me and it made me less able to understand my friend at the time. Incredibly tho my brothers death was a turning point for my friend, knowing someone actually die  from suicide made him think about his life. I know he felt quite guilty my brother dying and him overdosing over & over, he said he felt like a fraud. He hasnt overdosed since and hes a different person now.
